title: The Persistent Effects of Short-Term Peer Groups on Performance: Evidence from a Natural Experiment in Higher Education
eligible_reason: Natural experiment with random assignment of first-year students to short-term peer groups; cross-sectional OLS/logit of later outcomes on peer ability with randomization inference. No DiD or staggered-adoption design. Package ships synthetic data only.
design_notes: _rinf.ado: reg out treat $indep $fixed, cluster(groupid); logit counterparts; heterogeneity by own ability (peer_abilityXhigh/middle/low). Randomization inference via rerandomization.do.
data_files_note: README: original University of St. Gallen administrative data are proprietary; replication uses synthetic_data.dta built to mimic the data structure and main findings.
data_provenance_note: README states the shipped dataset is synthetic.
